final: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), total AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS n FROM station_counts), shares AS (SELECT station_counts.observstation, station_counts.n, 1.0 * station_counts.n / total.n AS share FROM station_counts JOIN total ON total.n IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(shares.n), AVG(shares.share), AVG(shares.share - mean_share.value) FROM shares JOIN mean_share ON mean_share.value IS NOT NULL WHERE shares.share > mean_share.value
